description: AIOProductOS connects ChatGPT to a product workspace where revenue, customer feedback, product analytics, delivery work and code all hang off one shared customer record. Users read the board and the product brain, capture feedback as insights and link it to features, run revenue-weighted NPS, NRR, funnel and retention analysis, manage OKRs, sprints and releases, work the support inbox, and create or update tasks — all against their own authenticated workspace. Because money, behaviour and feedback sit on the same record, users can ask which accounts requested a feature and what they pay, then act on the answer without leaving the conversation.

defaultPrompt: Give me a picture of my product right now: revenue, top accounts, and what customers are saying.
What changed in customer signal this week, and which themes are worth building?
Show me the signup to activation to paid funnel with the MRR behind each step.
